description: NaCaMgAl(SiO₃)₄ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.82 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.74 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.12 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-61°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-63°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Ca, one Mg, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one Al, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMgAlSi tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Ca, one Mg, one Al, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCaMgAlSi tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms.
